pictures.name: ZSM1-Gwalior-Fort
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters or writing of any script (no Gurmukhi), no logos or modern objects. Gentle and peaceful, no violence, no injury. The massive sandstone fort of Gwalior on its cliff at dusk, in the early 1600s: towering walls with blue-tiled towers, carved elephants on the gate, deep blue shadows and a last gold light on the battlements. Grand and imprisoning.

pictures.name: ZSM2-Prisoners
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters or writing of any script (no Gurmukhi), no logos or modern objects. Gentle and peaceful, no violence, no injury. A stone courtyard inside the fort: many captive princes in fine but faded silk robes and jewelled turbans sit dejected along the walls. In the middle, the Guru in a saffron robe and turban, seen only from behind, sits calmly with them, one prince leaning in to listen, a faint smile returning to his face. Lamplight on stone. The Guru is seen only from directly behind or very far away: no face, no profile, no cheek, no partial face is ever visible.

pictures.name: ZSM6-Amritsar-Lamps
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting in the same style, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. A modern scene painted like an old master. No readable text, letters or writing of any script (no Gurmukhi), no logos. The Golden Temple in Amritsar at night, glowing with thousands of lamps and lights for Bandi Chhor Divas, reflected in the dark sacred pool, crowds of Sikh families with covered heads lighting small clay lamps along the walkway, a few fireworks in the sky. Joyful, golden.
